name: Offline cached records are explicit; unseen records and other accounts stay unavailable
Offline entries persist complete payloads without sending anything
Mismatched payloads and offline edits cannot overwrite queued or saved records
Reconnect never uploads; only Sync now sends
Lost response after commit stays unconfirmed; retry reuses reference without duplicate
Missing/partial database receipts never mark an entry synced
Whole journal snapshot survives interrupted refresh without partial replacement
HTTP permission denial is never replaced by old cached data
Queued entries remain isolated by signed-in account
Indicator and detail panel show pending, confirmed, manual sync and last sync
Versioned app shell finishes caching and reopens without network
Pending and confirmed queue records survive reopening
